item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces have extended the siege of Hebron into a tenth day, arresting residents and threatening a wider offensive, while UN rights officials warn that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare. In the West Bank, settlers attacked a Palestinian town, wounding three olive harvesters and leaving a mother living in fear of her son’s killer. Israeli air strikes across Gaza have killed at least eight civilians, including a child, and caused severe trauma among hospital staff. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
